name: Dynamite Internet
summary: Canberra ISP (Dynamite Investments (ACT) Pty Ltd, ACN 072 264 012) that grew out of the Dynamite BBS (~1989-90); acquired Netinfo in 1998; acquired into the Edge/Eisa group c. 2000; domain redirected to AustarMetro ~2001-02 and ultimately reached iiNet via the AustarMetro -> Virtual Communities -> iiNet chain.

events.details: Company Profile: 'Dynamite Internet officially opened its door for operation on the 25 August 1995'; counter since 16 Aug 1995; predecessor Dynamite BBS Canberra ~1989-90 ('Canberra's Premier Internet Service Provider ... Since 1991' on dynamite.net.au 1997 refers to the BBS era). Dynamite Investments (ACT) Pty Ltd, ACN 072 264 012; tel (02) 6242 4000, info@dynamite.com.au.

events.details: Acquired into the Edge/Eisa group c. 2000 (Eisa Limited, trading as Edge Internet Services Australia; see eisa-limited + acquisition transition; Eisa registered 'EISA DYNAMITE' and 'DYNAMITE INTERNET CONSULTING/RETAIL/WEB MASTERS' business names). Last Dynamite-branded snapshots early 2001; domain redirected to AustarMetro by 2002 (dynamite.net.au served AustarMetro content Jun 2002); ultimately reached iiNet via AustarMetro -> Virtual Communities (2004).
